coverage_notes: Section 1(b)(iv) references an Acceptable Use Policy whose text is not supplied; its specific restrictions cannot be extracted. The express applicable-law duty in the same paragraph is covered by the existing use_compliance_law_and_aup clause.

Section 5(a) references Meta brand guidelines whose text is not supplied; their specific requirements cannot be extracted. The express mark restrictions and limited Llama-mark permission, including the duty to comply with the guidelines, are covered by existing clauses no_other_party_marks and llama_mark_model_naming_license.

Section 5(a)'s allocation of goodwill arising from use of the Mark to Meta is operative but does not express a behavior that can be represented by the fixed activity and object vocabulary. Section 5(b)'s allocation of ownership in Licensee-made derivatives and modifications, subject to Meta's ownership reservation, likewise cannot be represented as an activity constraint.

paragraph_audit.reason: The express applicable-law and trade-compliance duty is covered by the cited existing clause. The Acceptable Use Policy is incorporated by reference but is absent from the supplied materials, so its specific requirements are excluded rather than inferred.

The reciprocal mark restriction, limited Llama-mark permission, and brand-guidelines duty are covered by the cited existing clauses. The referenced brand guidelines are absent and their specific requirements are excluded. The separate allocation of goodwill to Meta is not representable as an activity constraint.

Section 5(b) allocates ownership of Licensee-made derivative works and modifications, subject to Meta's ownership reservation. An ownership allocation is not representable using the fixed activity and object vocabulary.
